panel.summary: No test covers the branch where only a custom `checkedValue` is set (uncheckedValue undefined)
panel.evidence: The new guard is `rule.checkedValue === undefined && rule.uncheckedValue === undefined`. The added tests cover (a) both undefined (data-validation.test.ts:93), (b) both set (:107), (c) uncheckedValue-only (:118). The checkedValue-only case — e.g. `{checkedValue: 'true'}` with default `uncheckedValue: 'FALSE'` — is never exercised, so flipping the `&&` to check only `uncheckedValue` (or dropping the `checkedValue === undefined` conjunct) would not fail any test.
